A complete outer cache container is not serialized or persisted by this measurement; the framing cost is included arithmetically. Full decoder state charged once. Sampled full-cache estimates assume measured bytes per record and are not full-cache measurements.

bf16_probe.scope: BF16 allocation and matmul functionality, not proof of native hardware execution or SDPA support

model_identity.placement: Explicit single device; no device_map, automatic offload, or remote code

traits.fallback_policy: explicit in registry_mechanism_counts and original codec diagnostics

sample.selection: evenly spaced selected-record ordinals, subject to combined byte budget

sample_decode.scope: CPU codec decode calls only; sample already in host memory, equality checking excluded; one warmup pass.

pageable.event_scope: Device stream elapsed time between events. For CPU decode+pack then copy, events can include CPU launch gaps and must not be read as pure copy-kernel time.

pinned.event_scope: Device stream elapsed time between events. For CPU decode+pack then copy, events can include CPU launch gaps and must not be read as pure copy-kernel time.

memory.scope: Allocator allocated bytes during this bounded operation, excluding pre-existing model/state baseline; reserved memory and host allocations are separate.

transfers.scope: Bounded sampled transfers with synchronized reusable device buffers. CPU reference encoded bytes are staging only: no GPU decoder for these original wire formats. End-to-end CPU decode+host pack then bulk H2D is serialized, with no attention or serving benchmark. Device-event durations can include host launch gaps.

memory.scope: Allocator allocated bytes during this bounded operation, excluding pre-existing model/state baseline; reserved memory and host allocations are separate.

measurement.rotation_basis: No preloaded rotation; any generated gpu_ops basis is identified by its recorded SHA256.

decoder_state_info.accounting: Actual distinct tensor storage bytes, including lazily created rotations; Python metadata and allocator reserved bytes are not included.

measurement.scope: Separately named tensor packet format, not a GPU implementation of the CPU entropy wire formats. Record input CPU→device staging, device encode and device decode are separately synchronized. Full cache is not retained on accelerator. Packet JSON headers and all physical tensor payload bytes are measured; specified 32-byte cache framing and offset costs are added arithmetically, with no complete outer container persisted. Prefetched validated host launch descriptors and CPU descriptor guards are included in native execution; authoritative JSON header parsing/validation occurs during explicit packet transfer/restore. CPU runs establish functionality only. No attention, concurrency, or admission benefit is measured.

sample_decode.scope: Sample packet already on target device for each isolated decode call; explicit packet copy and authoritative header parsing excluded. Decode includes CPU launch-descriptor guards. One warmup.

sample_packet_transfer_then_decode.scope: Explicit per-field pageable packet CPU→device copy plus synchronized device decode, allocation and authoritative JSON header validation included. CPU functional copy when no accelerator. Reconstructed-word validation D2H excluded.
